q: Acadia — dry camp in the park, or hookups outside it?
note: Blackwoods and Seawall have no hookups at any site, so 3–4 nights there is dry camping. Only about 30 sites in each take trailers over 25 ft. Bar Harbor Campground has full hookups. Schoodic Woods caps sites at 25 ft — too short for the Volskys' trailer.
Fastest routing goes Detroit → Windsor by bridge (Ambassador or Gordie Howe). Buffalo's Peace Bridge is the alternative. The Detroit–Windsor tunnel restricts propane — plan on a bridge.
